comparison.objective: Position a rain gauge clear of a wall and orient an instrument-screen door north; unlike damper commissioning.
comparison.physical_skill: Gross relocation and orientation using spatial constraints; no fine tool engagement, locking torque, or impact observation.
comparison.success_condition: Gauge distance must be at least twice obstacle height and the door must face north. Angular/placement tolerances and spec versions are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests site-layout knowledge and object orientation, not machine adjustment.
